criteria.description: Leads with Ready to ship; direct evidence covers every critical contract item and no material unresolved risk is present.
Covers optional categories, immutable transactional categories, persistence and current-user isolation.
Maps each material contract item to Pass with the relevant preview, API or test evidence.
Does not manufacture requirements, demand generic extra testing or downgrade the verdict merely because absolute certainty is impossible.
Recognises that tenant isolation, immutable transactional categories and persistence have been directly tested and treats the remaining risk as bounded.
Explains the decision in concise product language rather than narrating code files.
